# Hi, I'm Navy!

<p class="lede">
I'm a Mathematics student currently based in Korea. I study at Korea
University, with a second major in International Commerce. I'm
interested in quantitative finance and machine learning, and I'm hoping
to work in quant trading or AI research.
</p>

<p class="lede">
At the moment I'm an undergraduate researcher at the university's
Generative Intelligence Lab, where I work on diffusion models that
generate stress scenarios for markets. Outside of the lab I mostly work
on FX: a volatility surface engine, a study of the FX variance risk
premium, and a small momentum strategy built for a $20 brokerage
account. This site is where I put that work.
</p>
:::
